name: Discrete Laser — LaserDiode
description: Discrete through-hole laser diodes in the LaserDiode package family with KiCad symbols supporting LaserDiode_TO56-3 and LaserDiode_TO38ICut-3 footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring through-hole laser diodes in LaserDiode_TO56-3 or LaserDiode_TO38ICut-3 packages.
Choose between parts such as PL520, PLT5_450B, PLT5_510, and PLT5_488 based on footprint requirements.
Use for designs sourcing symbols from the KiCad symbol library.
avoid_when: Surface mount (SMD) packaging is required for the application.
The layout requires a footprint other than LaserDiode_TO56-3 or LaserDiode_TO38ICut-3.
Higher quality tier classification (such as Tier A) is required.
